main.description: Fulfillment policy whose evaluation logic is a caller-supplied Deno worker bundle rather than pre-defined registry policies. The bundle is untrusted third-party code: evaluators refuse to run it unless explicitly configured to allow untrusted policy execution. Carries downstream through subcontracting chains.

policies.description: Named policies evaluated by the bundle; all must allow.

manifest.description: Strong reference to a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.compute.deno.workerManifest holding the bundled policy code.

permissions.description: Deno sandbox permissions requested by the bundle (net, read, write, env, run, ffi, sys, import). Applied on top of the default deny-all posture.

requesterDid.description: ATProto DID of the root requester this policy set was minted for.

name.description: Name of this policy. Not a registry lookup — the code comes from the manifest.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this policy admits.

args.description: Arguments passed to the policy at evaluation time. Well-known keys: bidWindowSec, firstFree.
